title: DE E SAN Beachwalk Landing Miramar Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Waterfront Villa!* Waterfront Villa with Peaceful Lake Views* Private Sandestin Beach Access – Just a 3–5 Minute Golf Cart...
description_expanded: OverviewTop Reasons to Book this Fabulous Waterfront Villa!* Waterfront Villa with Peaceful Lake Views* Private Sandestin Beach Access – Just a 3–5 Minute Golf Cart Ride* 6-Seater Golf Cart Included* 4 Backpack Beach Chairs + Umbrella Included* Access to 2 Resort Pools + Beachwalk Pool* Championship Golf Courses & Resort Amenities* Tennis, Walking and Biking Trails Throughout Sandestin* Minutes to Baytowne Wharf and Grand Boulevard Dining, Shopping & Entertainment* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Beachwalk Landing is a professionally designed and completely remodeled waterfront villa located in the sought-after Beachwalk Villas at Sandestin in Miramar Beach. This luxurious two-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath townhome comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests and offers the perfect combination of upscale comfort and laid-back coastal living. Start your mornings with coffee on the private lakefront patio. Inside, Beachwalk Landing features beautiful designer décor, luxury finishes, and a thoughtfully designed layout. The gourmet kitchen offers quartz countertops, a large island, beverage fridge, and a convenient coffee and wine bar. The dining table and bar provide seating for up to 8, making it easy for everyone to gather for meals. Enjoy peaceful lake views from the private patio while enjoying your morning coffee. Bed SetupMaster Bedroom: King Bed + Twin-over-Twin BunkGuest Bedroom: King Bed + Twin-over-Twin BunkNOTICE: Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance by guests and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, decibel meters, and video surveillance, including the front door.Area Attractions: Be sure to check out the Village of Baytowne Wharf -- a beautiful 28-acre waterfront town center with a collection of unique shops, charming eateries, lively nightclubs, and year-round special events. Find an amazing array of things to do at Baytowne Wharf. Plenty to keep the kids happy – burn off some energy at the Adventureland Playground, test your courage at the Gulf Coast’s only zipline or ropes course at Baytowne Adventure Zone. Go back in time at the Carousel or head to the future at the Blast Arcade and Laser Maze, or the Boondocks Arcade. Want to get your shop on?? You’ll find a varied selection of shops right here in the Village, from a surf shop to funky clothing, shoes, and accessories, and everything in between: a wine shop, toy store, general store, and even an old-fashioned candy shop.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
